name: Ice Cream Chest Freezer
summary: Low commercial ice-cream chest with independent sliding glass panels and six plain frozen tubs.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python. No external models, scripts, textures, logos or fonts.
accuracy_notes: Static P1 commercial display prop. Two named lid nodes slide along X on separate tracks; gallery supplies no lid controls. Six generic ice-cream tubs with soft surface relief and scoop trails, no readable labels or brands. Partial-open authored pose. Unmaterialed collider_box is in an opt-in collision scene, outside the default visual scene. Physical devices, WebKit and full mall integration unverified. Not operational refrigeration.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials; no third-party assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
